title: dbo benchmark result
description: One run. The machine is recorded with the numbers because a figure without its hardware is unattributable, and a Pi 4 and a Pi 5 differ by two to three times.

profile.description: ram = PGDATA on tmpfs: a CPU and concurrency ceiling, NOT a storage figure, because fsync is free. nvme = what a deployment feels.

thermal.description: Sampled throughout. A run whose throttle flags latched is reported, not hidden — its numbers describe cooling rather than code.

valid.description: False when the run throttled, when tmpfs filled, or when any measurement failed to complete. An invalid run is kept and marked, never quietly dropped.

coldStartMs.description: Distribution boot to the first 200 on a current schema.

writeWithPdi.description: The same path with personal-data isolation on. The delta is the per-write cost of encrypting identifying elements.

tokenLookup.description: identifier=system|value — 88 of 206 measured production call sites are this one shape, so it is weighted as reality weights it.

feedLagMs.description: Consumer lag across every tenant database under write load. The differentiated measurement: N tenant databases on one instance is exactly what the commit-fence fast path exists for.

tenantsBeforeDegradation.description: How many tenants one JVM holds before latency leaves its band. A product limit an edge deployment has to be told.
